Package com.salesforce.multicloudj.blob.ali

Class OssClientFactory

java.lang.Object
com.salesforce.multicloudj.blob.ali.OssClientFactory
public final class OssClientFactory extends Object
Builds and configures Alibaba OSS SDK clients (sync OSSClient and async OSSAsyncClient) from the MultiCloudJ builder configuration.

The sync and async clients are constructed from distinct SDK builder types, but both implement the SDK's BaseClientBuilder contract and map the same MultiCloudJ settings (region, credentials, endpoint, proxy, retry, timeouts, connection pool) the same way. This factory centralizes that mapping so the two code paths cannot drift. Callers supply the SDK builder, the resolved credentials and retryer, and a OssClientFactory.HttpClientFactory that knows how to build the transport client appropriate for that client kind (the only sync-vs-async difference).

  • Method Details

    • resolveReadWriteTimeout

      public static Duration resolveReadWriteTimeout(RetryConfig retryConfig, Duration socketTimeout)
      Resolves the value for the Ali SDK's single readWriteTimeout setting from the two MultiCloudJ inputs that map onto it. RetryConfig.attemptTimeout (the more specific per-attempt deadline) takes precedence over the transport-level socketTimeout; if neither is set, returns null so the SDK default is left in place.

    • configure

      public static <B extends com.aliyun.sdk.service.oss2.BaseClientBuilder<B, T>, T> void configure(B clientBuilder, BlobStoreBuilder<?> mcjBuilder, com.aliyun.sdk.service.oss2.credentials.CredentialsProvider creds, com.aliyun.sdk.service.oss2.retry.Retryer retryer, OssClientFactory.HttpClientFactory httpClientFactory)
      Applies the shared MultiCloudJ → OSS SDK configuration to clientBuilder: region, credentials, optional endpoint/proxy/retryer, and the read-write timeout. Connection-pool size and idle-connection timeout are only settable via HttpClientOptions, not on the client builder, so when the caller sets either we build an explicit transport client from those options (carrying proxyHost + readWriteTimeout forward so nothing the builder would otherwise set is lost); when neither is set we leave the SDK to construct its own default client and set readWriteTimeout directly.
      Parameters:
      clientBuilder - the SDK sync or async client builder to configure
      mcjBuilder - the MultiCloudJ builder carrying the user configuration
      creds - the resolved OSS credentials provider (must be non-null)
      retryer - the resolved OSS retryer, or null for none
      httpClientFactory - builds the transport client appropriate for this client kind
